name: A-League Women
headline: A-League Women Finals & Championship Odds

rules.summary: 11 clubs (Wellington Phoenix from New Zealand), 20 games each over 22 matchweeks: home and away against everyone, with two byes per club. 3 points a win, 1 a draw. Clubs level on points are separated by goal difference, goals scored, wins, head-to-head points, head-to-head goal difference, fewest Fair Play points, away goal difference, away goals per away game, home goal difference, home goals per home game, then a coin toss or drawing of lots. The best record wins the Premiers Plate. The top six reach the Finals Series: 3rd hosts 6th and 4th hosts 5th in single-match Elimination Finals; 1st plays the lower-ranked Elimination Final winner and 2nd the higher-ranked one in two-legged Semi-Finals on aggregate (no away goals; 1st and 2nd choose which leg to host, and have taken the second leg); the Grand Final is one match hosted by the higher-placed finalist. A finals match or tie level after normal time goes to extra time, then penalties. The Grand Final winners are the Champions. The 2026-27 competition rules have not been published yet, so these are the 2025-26 rules; the 2026-27 fixture keeps 11 clubs, 22 matchweeks and two byes each, starting on 17 October 2026.

notes: Finals: the top six qualify. 3rd hosts 6th and 4th hosts 5th in Elimination Finals; 1st and 2nd then play the lower- and higher-ranked winners over two legs, with the second leg at 1st's and 2nd's grounds, and the higher-placed finalist hosts the Grand Final. Every level finals match or tie goes to extra time, then penalties.
The Fair Play tiebreaker (cards) is not in the data; ESPN's published order, which matches aleagues.com.au, is used whenever its records agree with the results.
These are the 2025-26 competition rules; the A-Leagues have not yet published 2026-27's.

Backtested on 2024-25 and 2025-26: week-ahead match predictions score 0.228 (ranked probability score) against 0.236 for home/draw/away base rates (0.223 v 0.234 in 2024-25, 0.235 v 0.240 in 2025-26), and finals, top-two, premiership and title odds at a quarter, half and three quarters of each season scored best with the usual strength drift of 0.2.
